title: DESQ: Dynamic-Flooding Transformer Ensembles for Reinforcement-Learning-Based Equity Market Timing (v1.2-desq)
description: Reference implementation for the revised IEEE Access paper. This v1.2-desq release aligns to the complete 28-page authority, adds deterministic per-stock nine-seed median-agent selection, updates Appendix A1/C1 artifacts, and separates Appendix F alarms from repository-defined update policy. Retained DES/CUSUM outputs remain explicitly labeled legacy diagnostics rather than DDQN reproductions.
